recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless a future work-group decision intentionally changes root-level mustSupport semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-34347 asked FHIR core to address confusing mustSupport semantics on profile/extension root elements. Its Published / Not Persuasive with Modification resolution required a best-practice invariant warning that the root element of a profile should not have mustSupport=true because mustSupport is determined by the referencing element/type context.
initial_application: Historical commit a9fc52f30b8e64be902b7bc30186f6a3cd9179c2 added constraint sdf-26 to source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-StructureDefinition.xml for FHIR-34347. The current source retains the invariant, with the detailed rationale in the best-practice explanation extension and the concise human text/expression attached to StructureDefinition.snapshot.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists structuredefinition=StructureDefinition as an active build resource. The originating Zulip thread supported filing a StructureDefinition tracker for root-level mustSupport, and Patient Care IPS minutes later referenced FHIR-34347 while removing root-level mustSupport from IPS profiles. Later FHIR-50391 clarifies mustSupport and obligations for repeating elements and slices but does not reverse the root-profile invariant.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current build-scoped StructureDefinition source already contains sdf-26, including the best-practice marker, explanation, human text, and FHIRPath expression checking element[0].mustSupport.
